# Rida Naz - Full Profile

Rida Naz is a Full Stack Developer and Agentic AI Engineer based in Karachi, Pakistan. She builds production AI systems, voice agents, agentic workflows, RAG knowledge systems, and full stack SaaS platforms for founders, startups, AI teams, and technical clients.

## Positioning
Rida builds AI systems that automate real business operations. Her work focuses on practical production use cases where AI needs to reason, retrieve context, call tools, speak with users, update systems, and support real workflows.

## Current Role
Rida is a founding team member and Lead Engineer at TalkifAI, an early-stage AI voice agent platform. Her responsibilities include voice infrastructure, backend architecture, platform workflows, and production deployment foundations.

At TalkifAI, she has worked on LiveKit voice pipelines, SIP/WebRTC infrastructure, BYOC telephony with Twilio and Telnyx, RAG knowledge bases, batch calling, multi-tenant platform architecture, and Google Cloud deployment.

## Technical Stack
Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, FastAPI, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker, Google Cloud, LiveKit, SIP/WebRTC, Twilio, Telnyx, LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Code, MCP servers, RAG pipelines, REST APIs, webhooks, and cloud deployment workflows.

## Specializations
- Voice AI agents and realtime communication systems
- Agentic workflows and multi-agent systems
- Tool-using AI agents with APIs and MCP servers
- RAG knowledge systems and domain assistants
- Full stack SaaS products and dashboards
- Backend architecture for AI products
- AI automation integrations
- Agentic SEO and AI-readable portfolio architecture

## Services
### Voice AI Agent Build
For support, sales, booking, phone-based workflows, and conversational business operations. Deliverables may include LiveKit/SIP voice pipelines, telephony integration, agent flow design, backend APIs, and deployment support.

### Agentic Workflow Automation
For teams replacing repetitive internal work with AI agents that can plan, call tools, update systems, and keep humans in the loop. Common tools include LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, MCP, APIs, and workflow logging.

### RAG Knowledge Assistant
For products or teams with business knowledge stored in documents, policies, product data, or support content. Work may include ingestion pipelines, retrieval strategy, context engineering, and assistant UX.

### Full Stack AI SaaS MVP
For founders and startups that need a usable AI product interface, backend, database, auth, and deployment path. Common stack includes Next.js, TypeScript, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker, and cloud services.

### AI Integration Layer
For businesses that need AI connected to CRMs, databases, APIs, webhooks, dashboards, and internal tools.

### Agentic SEO and AI Visibility
For portfolios and technical brands that need search engine visibility and AI-agent readability through metadata, schema, llms.txt, sitemap structure, and crawlable content.

## Featured Projects
### TalkifAI
AI voice agent platform for creating, deploying, and scaling voice agents. Rida is a founding team member and Lead Engineer. Her work includes LiveKit and SIP infrastructure, BYOC telephony, backend platform systems, RAG knowledge-base workflows, batch calling, and deployment foundations.

### Personal AI Employee
Autonomous digital worker concept using Claude Code, MCP, Azure, and full stack orchestration to monitor channels and execute actions across connected tools.

### TalkifAI Customer Success FTE
Production-grade AI support agent concept with a multi-step agentic pipeline and event-driven architecture for async multi-channel message streaming.

### Agentic Todo with MCP
Full stack task management app using natural language AI interactions and MCP tools. Built with FastAPI, SQLModel, Neon PostgreSQL, and a stateless AI chat interface.

### AI Native Book
Technical textbook on Physical AI and humanoid robotics with an integrated RAG chatbot for querying book content.

### JungleMug
Amazon listing automation platform with AI content generation, mockup automation, and Amazon SP-API integration.
